category_title: Students with high callous-unemotional (CU) traits and proactive aggression
scenario_title: Playtime conflict and proactive aggression over a ball
minimal_context: The student is at playtime and wants to start a game of football using a ball that another boy is currently playing with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is playtime now. You can go outside and choose an activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to start my own game of football.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and find what you need to play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to play with the ball that boy is playing with.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: He is using it right now. What do you think you should do?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the other boy hard to the ground to take the ball) If I hurt him, he will stop playing with the ball, then I can use it to start my own game of football.
